section_title: C07 wallet ownership, source rights, balance states and financial semantics
section_summary: A visible wallet is distinct from internal ledger accounts; personal and organization ownership are separate from credit provenance. Cash, gifts and transferred credit retain provenance and distinct cashability/expiry rights; ordinary transfer cannot create withdrawal rights. Pending, confirmed, reserved, spendable, withdrawable and transferable are distinct. Consumption order follows source/expiry and active caps take precedence. Amounts store integer IRR and display toman with explicit conversion; cumulative rounding is nearest rial, half-up. Termination cannot erase valid cash claims. The 20 REQs/tests are planning only; bank, legal/accounting, schema and technical choices stay open.

section_title: C13a pricing, metering, settlement and accounting evidence
section_summary: C13a separates subscription (C04), assistant per-run tariff and adviser consumption. Adviser billing uses billable prompt units and analysis intensity with aggregation rules; model calls/retries/substeps are not billable customer prompts unless separately specified.
